items.t: CrowdStrike: The $44B Zscaler Merger Unlocks An Agentic AI Powerhouse
items.sum: Analyst rates CrowdStrike a Strong Buy: its $43.9 billion Zscaler deal could build an AI platform, targeting $1 billion in annualized revenue synergies.

items.t: Was CrowdStrike’s $43.9 Billion Bid for Zscaler the Right Move at the Wrong Time?
items.sum: CrowdStrike just posted its best quarter ever, then paid a fortune in stock for a rival whose own guidance vanished. Investors now face a year of waiting to learn whether strength or ambition sets the price.

items.t: Truist Sees 52% Upside in Zscaler, and the Reason Has Nothing to Do With Zscaler’s Valuation
items.sum: Key TakeawaysTruist kept its Buy rating on Zscaler and raised its price target to $340 from $250, 52% above Wednesday’s close. The $340 matches Truist’s $300 CrowdStrike target times 1.

items.t: CrowdStrike Keeps Sliding After Its Zscaler Deal: Why Argus Still Sees 67% Upside
